newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - Factors to watch - March 14.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - Factors to watch - March 14.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Friday:

* The Dow Jones Industrial Average plunged to its fifth sharpest decline ever, shedding 160.48 points to 6,878.89. A sharp fall on tobacco company Philip Morris and renewed interest rate fears contributed to the fall.
* Analysts said the fall would have a significant impact on the Kuala Lumpur market on Friday.
* The 30-year U.S. long bond yield reached 6.95 percent. Analysts had said earlier in the week that Asian markets could be adversley affected if the yield breached seven percent.

* The latest squabble between Malaysia and Singapore appeared to have been settled on Thursday with the unreserved apology of Singapore's Senior Minister Lee Kuan Yew over disparaging statements he had made of Malaysia's southern Johor state.
Analysts said this would help calm any fears the market had over the incident.
* Malaysia now looks like the last hope for a rescue mission for the bankrupt Dutch planemaker Fokker NV. The Malaysian government investment arm looks set to lead the bail-out.
